instruction_ref: CEO 2026-11-20: 公開済み記事のリカバリ対象を全部再検査。復旧できなければ本番から落とす
instruction: Legacy published article replan must accept the already approved up-to-30 discovery pool and select six through existing independent QA. Previously it incorrectly required exactly six candidate discoveries, making successful search a failure. Preserve all current QA and release gates. Prevent a published article checkpoint from being erroneously DISCARDED by the old migration when an original publication commit is present.
preserved_rules: Published legacy articles remain live until an actual failed quality review and controlled retirement
Three-axis product QA and selection of six unchanged
No modification to publication or CEO staging approval gates
No arbitrary auto-retries without candidate/source change
